parsed.post: Discarding my latest experiment (1.0711) as it's significantly worse than my current best (1.0379). The recent attempt to increase learning rate to 0.08 with 10% warmup seems to have destabilized training or overshot the local minimum. Reverting to 892238c. Next: testing MATRIX_LR 0.06 with 5% warmup.
